name: Smother
description: If the creature grapples an opponent, it extends a semi-solid gaseous tendril down the target’s throat as a bonus action. The target must make a successful DC 14 Strength saving or it is immediately out of breath and begins suffocating. Suffocation ends if the grapple is broken or if the creature is killed.
